Notifications.description: Configures the notification center. The values can also be defined per tenant under 'OrchardCore:{TenantName}:Notifications'. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Notifications/.

TotalUnreadNotifications.description: The maximum number of unread notifications displayed in the navigation bar.

DisableNotificationHtmlBodySanitizer.description: Whether to disable the sanitization of the HTML body of the notifications sent from workflows.

AbsoluteCacheExpirationSeconds.description: The absolute expiration in seconds of the cached unread notifications displayed in the navigation bar. A value of 0 means no absolute expiration. The notifications are only cached when this value or 'SlidingCacheExpirationSeconds' is greater than 0.

SlidingCacheExpirationSeconds.description: How long in seconds the cached unread notifications can be inactive before being removed. This does not extend the lifetime beyond 'AbsoluteCacheExpirationSeconds' when set. A value of 0 disables the sliding expiration.

OrchardCore_Notifications.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Notifications' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Notifications' instead.
